title: Suspended Days and Claim Days Set Aside on Workplace Cafe Management Program Sites
content:
A client whose site closes its own doors for part of the year still has claim days standing approved on its workplace cafe management contract under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, and the closure record the client has built up over the contract year governs how many of those claim days are set aside.

Where two or more suspension requests stand approved on the contract and ten or more suspended calendar days stand against the current contract year, the extended closure claim days are set aside. Where exactly one suspension request stands approved on the contract and ten or more suspended calendar days stand against the current contract year, the short closure claim days are set aside. Where fewer than ten suspended calendar days stand against the current contract year, no claim day is set aside.

The extended closure claim days set aside are 2 claim days. The short closure claim days set aside are 1 claim day.

Judged on the two readings the contract shows:

- Suspension requests standing approved on the contract: 2 or more, exactly 1, or none. The reading is of requests standing approved, not of requests logged.
- Suspended calendar days standing against the current contract year: 10 or more, or fewer than 10. The count is of calendar days in the contract year now running, not of days in any earlier contract year.

| Suspension requests standing approved | Suspended calendar days in the current contract year | Claim days set aside |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 10 or more | 2 |
| exactly 1 | 10 or more | 1 |
| any number | fewer than 10 | none |

Both parts of a compound condition hold together. A site hypothetically showing 3 approved suspension requests but only 9 suspended calendar days against the current contract year has no claim day set aside, because the day count falls short of ten; the same site at 10 suspended calendar days has 2 claim days set aside. A site hypothetically showing 1 approved suspension request and 14 suspended calendar days against the current contract year has 1 claim day set aside.
